exposure: Baogong Zhixue granules combined with tranexamic acid injection
Tranexamic acid injection combined with oxytocin
outcome: Amount of bleeding at 2 h and 24 h after delivery
cohort: 90 women who underwent cesarean section and experienced postpartum hemorrhage.
finding: Baogong Zhixue granules combined with tranexamic acid injection was associated with less postpartum bleeding, more stable hemodynamics, and improved coagulation function compared to tranexamic acid injection combined with oxytocin.
